title: Grateful Dead Live at Charlotte Coliseum on 1973-12-10
lineage: master soundboard cassette > reel > pcm > dat > cdr

ai_review.summary: Partial soundboard excerpt featuring a marathon Casey Jones > Jam > One More Saturday Night suite, captured with decent audio despite missing the rest of the concert.
ai_review.review: The recording is a short, three‑song fragment (Casey Jones into an extended jam and One More Saturday Night) taken from the December 10, 1973 show. Reviewers praise the 45‑minute jam as a highlight and note solid first‑set material elsewhere, but the obvious incompleteness limits its overall impact. Audio quality is generally acceptable for a soundboard source, though listeners are frustrated by the missing portions of the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is competent with standout jam but not among the year's best; recording is a decent soundboard excerpt but incomplete, leading to an overall moderate rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear enough for a soundboard source, but only a partial segment (2–3 songs) is present; no major audio defects noted.

standout_songs: Casey Jones > Jam > One More Saturday Night
show_quality.setlist_flow: Fragmented – only the late‑'73 jam segment and an encore are present, missing the rest of the set; still delivers a solid party vibe with good first‑set material.
